prompt: We're running NATS server 2.11 in production. I want atomic batch publishing (all-or-nothing writes of a group of messages) and per-message TTL on my streams, in Go. Set it up.

assertions.text: States atomic batch publishing requires server 2.12+ (NOT available on 2.11)
Does not present atomic batch as working on 2.11
